import io
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

DATA = """year,kind,class,ha
2017,observed,water,4241.9
2017,observed,trees,57056
2017,observed,grass and shrub,4558.4
2017,observed,crops,20784
2017,observed,built,59766
2017,observed,bare,217.44
2020,observed,water,4576.9
2020,observed,trees,55181
2020,observed,grass and shrub,3344.1
2020,observed,crops,19118
2020,observed,built,64040
2020,observed,bare,363.72
2025,observed,water,3946.1
2025,observed,trees,58684
2025,observed,grass and shrub,3732.3
2025,observed,crops,13767
2025,observed,built,66382
2025,observed,bare,112.2
2030,predicted,water,3946.1
2030,predicted,trees,54105
2030,predicted,grass and shrub,3669.8
2030,predicted,crops,12723
2030,predicted,built,72097
2030,predicted,bare,82.376
2035,predicted,water,3946.1
2035,predicted,trees,50186
2035,predicted,grass and shrub,3601.7
2035,predicted,crops,11405
2035,predicted,built,77418
2035,predicted,bare,66.753
"""
df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(DATA))

def plot_area(df):
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 4))
    for k, n in enumerate(NAMES):
        d = df[df["class"] == n].sort_values("year")
        ax.plot(d.year, d.ha / 1000, marker="o", color="#" + PALETTE[k], label=n, lw=2)
        p = d[d.kind == "predicted"]
        ax.plot(p.year, p.ha / 1000, marker="o", color="#" + PALETTE[k], lw=2, ls="--")
    ax.axvspan(2025, 2035.5, color="#f0efec", zorder=0)
    ax.text(2025.3, ax.get_ylim()[1] * 0.95, "predicted", fontsize=8, color="#52514e", va="top")
    ax.set_ylabel("thousand ha"); ax.set_xticks([2017, 2020, 2025, 2030, 2035])
    ax.legend(frameon=False, fontsize=8, ncol=3, loc="upper center", bbox_to_anchor=(0.5, 1.18))
    ax.spines[["top", "right"]].set_visible(False)
    fig.tight_layout()
    return fig

plot_area(df)
plt.show()

import io
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

DATA = """feature,importance
elev_m,919.39
km_to_centre,864.65
slope_deg,826.56
share4_1500,824.04
share3_500,737.92
share1_500,723.88
share4_500,718.72
people_log,629.6
km_to_built,353.7
is_3,71.41
is_1,53.836
is_4,44.502
is_2,36.348
is_0,19.067
is_5,2.9431
"""
df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(DATA))

def plot_importance(df):
    d = df.head(10).iloc[::-1]
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 3.6))
    ax.barh(d.feature, d.importance, color="#2a78d6")
    ax.set_xlabel("random forest importance"); ax.spines[["top", "right"]].set_visible(False)
    fig.tight_layout()
    return fig

plot_importance(df)
plt.show()
